label: measured receptor via genome-wide genetic screens on E. coli K-12 BW25113
independence: DIFFERENT LAB, measured labels, non-Bas isolates disjoint from the BASEL-2021 reference (Bas## excluded as leakage); K-12 host comparable to BASEL
honest_reading: The OVERALL number is dragged down by CLASS COVERAGE: the shipped v0 catalogue only contains reference phages for classes ['BtuB', 'ECA', 'LPS_core', 'LptD', 'NfrA'], so it cannot predict the RBP-variable classes (Tsx/OmpC/FhuA/OmpA/OmpF/...) that dominate the independent set — those are exactly the (3) RBP-caller scope. The COVERED-SUBSET accuracy is the fair independent test of what v0 CLAIMS to decode.
